q1_issues.issue: (Name silk_road "Silk Road") is emitted with no relation attaching it to Bam, leaving an orphan symbol; a proper noun premodifying a common-noun head ("Silk Road city") is licensed to link by the opaque (Possession bam silk_road).

(Member sk_worker_1 international) predicates a member-level descriptive modifier of the group symbol, which the instruction set explicitly warns against — such a modifier distributes over the members, and a bare (Member <group> <prop>) is only for a property of the collection itself.

Neither distributive predicate gets the per-member distribution rule the instruction set requires for a grouped plural (hack over the rescue-worker group, overflow over the cemetery group), so a member named later would not be reachable.

notes: Good calls elsewhere: "survivors" stays a bare kind filler rather than a witness (no survivors asserted to exist), "city of Bam" licenses (Member bam city) off the stated kind word, "Iran's ... city" is LocatedIn rather than PartOf/Possession, and no type atom is invented for Iran.
